rule_title: TTP T1562.001 - Defender Exclusion via Set-MpPreference ExclusionPath (ScriptBlock EID 4104)
description: Detects Set-MpPreference -ExclusionPath being used to add a path exclusion via PowerShell ScriptBlock logging. The ScriptBlockText field contains the decoded, fully expanded command text, making this reliable even when the invocation is obfuscated at the process level. Excluding a directory shelters all tools and payloads placed within it from Defender scanning. Any exclusion path in a user-writable location (Temp, AppData, user home directories, or explicitly named tool directories) is high confidence malicious.
